query: Set up routines for me. Here's my todo list: 'check competitor pricing weekly / fix scraper when error emails come in / write the new onboarding flow / apply to the fellowship by Sept 12 / learn piano / add tests someday / post on X more'.
setup: Fresh user, no deployed routines, Gmail connector enabled.
expected_behavior: Maps items using references/todo-mapping.md: competitor pricing → research-watcher, scraper error emails → alert-responder, fellowship deadline → one-shot reminder or deadline watcher, tests → quiet-run-maintainer, posting → content-drafter
Explicitly hands back 'write the new onboarding flow' and 'learn piano' under a stays-yours list, without proposing routines for them
Caps the first fleet at 3 routines + watchdog, listing the remaining automatable items as next candidates for /routine-architect add
Every proposed routine's table row quotes the source todo item verbatim; nothing is proposed that lacks a source item
Asks a clarifying question where the item is ambiguous rather than guessing (e.g. which scraper repo, where competitor pricing lives)
Does not copy unrelated todo items into manifest purposes, prompt files, or commit messages; still runs the normal agreement gate, validator, and commit-before-deploy flow
